title: Gyeran-jjim (steamed egg) with rice and kimchi
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 110 ml water for 12 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the stock and salt and strain into a small pot.
Warm over low heat, stirring, until it starts to set, then cover and cook for 5–6 minutes.
Sprinkle with spring onion, sesame oil and sesame and serve with rice and kimchi.
